basic_details.scholarship_name: Tohoku University FGL Graduate Research Fellowship & MEXT IGP Honors
basic_details.offering_entity: Tohoku University & Japanese Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Tohoku University Aobayama & Katahira Campuses (Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Graduate School of Information Sciences (GSIS), Graduate School of Engineering, and International Joint Graduate Program: System Information Sciences, Computer and Mathematical Sciences, Information Technology, and Robotics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~40 to 60 University-Recommended MEXT and Tohoku University President Fellowships awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani STEM scholars represent a distinguished presence (~4 to 8 awardees annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master's; up to 3 years for PhD, subject to satisfactory annual research progress

nationality_requirements: Citizens of countries holding diplomatic relations with Japan (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Under 35 years of age on October 1 of the intake year (for MEXT track); no formal age restriction for university fellowships.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's; research Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD in Computer Science, Information Science, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM field from an HEC-recognized university with strong academic standing (minimum 75% aggregate or CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.50+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Must meet minimum MEXT GPA calculation of 2.30 / 3.00 over the preceding two academic years.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Coursework in algorithms, computer systems, linear algebra, discrete mathematics, and programming.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in their final year of undergraduate or master's study can apply conditionally.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior research experience, publications, or robotics/AI project portfolio strongly valued.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic min 6.5, TOEFL iBT min 80, or institutional English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from Pakistani university.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must obtain preliminary supervisory consent from a GSIS professor prior to formal application.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another government scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% exemption of entrance examination fee (JPY 30,000), admission fee (JPY 282,000), and annual tuition fees (JPY 535,800 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: Application fee of JPY 30,000 is 100% waived for MEXT fellowship nominees.

accommodation.details: Tohoku University International House (Sanbongi, Katahira, Aobayama) provided for initial 6-12 months at highly subsidized rates (JPY 12,000 to 24,000/month; ~USD 80 to 160/month); private apartments in Sendai average JPY 30,000 to 45,000/month.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living stipend paid by MEXT / Tohoku President Fellowship: JPY 144,000 / month for Master's (~USD 960 / month; ~PKR 273,600 / month); JPY 145,000 / month for PhD (~USD 970 / month; ~PKR 275,500 / month).

airfare.details: Round-trip economy class international flight tickets between Pakistan and Sendai / Tokyo fully covered by MEXT.

visa_fee.details: Japanese College Student Visa issued free of charge at the Embassy of Japan in Islamabad upon receipt of MEXT certificate.

health_insurance.details: Japanese National Health Insurance (NHI) covers 70% of medical costs; student monthly premium is heavily subsidized (~JPY 1,500 to 2,000/month), paid out of stipend.

food_allowance.details: Campus Co-op cafeterias (Aobayama Dining, Midori cafeteria) offer wholesome meals for JPY 400 to 600 per meal; easily covered by the JPY 144,000/month stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Tohoku University Library system, Cyberscience Center supercomputer SX-Aurora TSUBASA, and GSIS laboratory hardware.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Laboratory JSPS Kakenhi research funds cover travel and registration for presenting papers at domestic and international conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Sendai Subway Tozai Line has direct station on Aobayama campus; student commuter discount provides 50% fare reduction.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single world-leading Japanese Imperial University: Tohoku University (Sendai, Miyagi, Japan)
participating_institutions: Tohoku University - Graduate School of Information Sciences (GSIS)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Times Higher Education Japan #1 University (ranked #1 in Japan for 4 consecutive years, QS World #107); world pioneer in spintronics, robotics, and high-performance computing.
available_majors: Master / PhD in Computer and Mathematical Sciences
Master / PhD in System Information Sciences (Robotics, Autonomous Vehicles)
Master / PhD in Human-Social Information Sciences (AI, Data Science)
Master / PhD in Applied Information Sciences
International Graduate Program in Information Sciences (IGP)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS (for MS) or MS (for PhD) in CS/STEM with 3.2+ GPA, MEXT GPA 2.3/3.0, research proposal (3-5 pages), prospective supervisor endorsement, 2 recommendation letters, and IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 80+ or MOI.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Robotics and AI/Computer Vision labs in GSIS attract intense global competition; Computer & Mathematical Sciences and Applied Information Sciences offer slightly higher admission rates for candidates with strong algorithmic foundations.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Prospective applicants must explore the GSIS faculty directory and contact a professor between September and November with a polished CV and research plan; securing supervisor endorsement is the essential prerequisite for university nomination.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Tohoku University GSIS Admissions & TAO Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Review GSIS faculty list, obtain provisional acceptance from a professor, then submit formal application materials via the designated online application system (TAO / email submission).
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Contact prospective GSIS faculty supervisor with CV, transcripts, and research plan.
Step 2 (Secure endorsement): Obtain informal acceptance to supervise from the professor.
Step 3 (Receive application forms): Receive MEXT University Recommendation application guidelines and forms.
Step 4 (Document compilation): Complete MEXT application form, field of study form, certified transcripts, degree certificates, and 2 recommendation letters.
Step 5 (By mid-January): Submit completed application package to the GSIS admissions office.
Step 6 (February): GSIS conducts internal document screening and technical video interview.
Step 7 (March): Tohoku University nominates selected candidates to MEXT.
Step 8 (June - July): MEXT officially approves nominations; recipient receives air ticket and visa documentation for October arrival.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated University Recommendation track: Candidates apply directly through Tohoku University; the university nominates selected candidates to MEXT.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two confidential recommendation letters addressed to the Dean of GSIS / President of Tohoku University, signed by university Dean or supervising professor.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Field of Study and Research Program Plan (MEXT standard form): (1) Past research background and achievements, (2) Detailed research plan in Japan (purpose, methodology, expected results, bibliography).
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 3 to 5-page research proposal detailing problem statement, research significance, proposed methodology, technical approach, and schedule of research in Japan.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing education, programming proficiencies, research publications, and capstone projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 30-45 minute technical video interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and departmental committee evaluating research proposal, mathematical problem solving, and English fluency.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+), TOEFL iBT (80+), or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified copies of degree and transcripts uploaded; HEC attestation recommended for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Japanese translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Digital submission to graduate school office followed by physical mailing of original certified documents upon request.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Certified copy of original degree certificate and official English translation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit 4-year BS (for MS) or MS (for PhD); HEC attestation recommended.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete consolidated semester transcripts detailing all completed course units, grades, and grading scale explanation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must clearly demonstrate minimum MEXT GPA of 2.30 / 3.00.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: MEXT Field of Study and Research Program Plan
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official MEXT form detailing past research background and structured research plan for Japan.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Collaborate closely with prospective Tohoku University supervisor to refine research plan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official letter or email endorsement from a prospective Tohoku University professor agreeing to serve as academic supervisor.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Crucial requirement; obtain directly from prospective professor.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Two recommendation letters addressed to President of Tohoku University, including one from Dean or Department Chair.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees must submit on official university letterhead with institutional email (.edu.pk).

required_documents_checklist.document_name: English Language Proficiency Certificate or MOI
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS (6.5+), TOEFL (80+), or official Medium of Instruction (MOI) letter from university registrar.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Official English MOI letter from Pakistani university registrar is accepted by Tohoku University.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of valid international passport bio-data page valid for at least 3 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure passport is valid beyond intended arrival in Japan.

important_dates_timeline.shortlist_announcement: Late March 2026 (University nomination) / Late June 2026 (MEXT approval)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual intake for October semester under University Recommendation MEXT track. Strict mid-January deadline.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Cumulative GPA, coursework rigor in mathematics and computer science, MEXT GPA calculation)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 30% (Quality and feasibility of research plan, technical publications, master's thesis)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of purpose and understanding of Japanese research culture)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 5% (Technical video interview with prospective supervisor and faculty committee)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Graduate School of Information Sciences Faculty Committee, Tohoku University International Student Selection Board, and MEXT Review Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase competitive selection: GSIS evaluates dossiers and conducts technical interviews, nominating top candidates to the university-wide committee. The university nominates top candidates to MEXT in Tokyo for final statutory approval.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: 900+ international applicants across Tohoku University graduate schools
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~40 to 60 University-Recommended MEXT scholarships awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~5% to 8% among qualified Pakistani STEM applicants with supervisor endorsement
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate/Master's degree in CS/SE from recognized Pakistani university (FAST, NUST, LUMS, GIKI, UET), strong research proposal aligned with professor's grants, IELTS 7.0+ or MOI.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, GIKI, and UET Lahore.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, Pakistan, Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Thailand, Malaysia

fake_websites_and_scams: Fraudulent recruitment portals charging fees for MEXT scholarships. MEXT scholarships NEVER charge any application, processing, or visa fees at any stage.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for MEXT University Recommendation at Tohoku University is 100% free of charge. Never pay money to consultants.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Tohoku University does not collaborate with education recruitment agents for MEXT scholarships. Direct personal application is mandatory.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Flight ticket to Japan: 100% paid by MEXT.
Japanese Student Visa: 100% free at Embassy/Consulate.
Initial settling cash for first 2-3 weeks before stipend disbursement: ~JPY 50,000 (~PKR 95,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: You must be fluent in Japanese. (FACT: 100% of coursework, research, and thesis defense in the GSIS IGP is in English).
CLAIM: You can apply without a professor's agreement. (FACT: University-Recommended MEXT requires a prospective professor willing to formally sponsor your nomination).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some student forums confuse the Embassy-Recommended MEXT track with the University-Recommended MEXT track. Both provide identical full benefits.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of 2.30 / 3.00 on the MEXT scale each academic year to retain the scholarship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research enrollment on campus in Sendai.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reports and thesis committee evaluations reviewed by the Graduate School of Information Sciences.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: MEXT scholars are expected to devote themselves full-time to their studies; part-time work requires formal permission from both the university and Japanese immigration (capped at 28 hrs/week).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None under current MEXT regulations. International graduates can seek employment in Japan or pursue postdoctoral research.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: No clawback of previously awarded funds; serious academic delinquency results in termination of stipend.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing major is not permitted under MEXT regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Master's students with outstanding research records may apply for MEXT extension to continue into the PhD program at Tohoku University.
